display_long_description:
BlockView is a VR puzzle game that challenges how you see space.

Each level presents you with multiple 2D projection views—
orthographic perspectives like top, front, back, left, and right views.
Your goal is to place 3D blocks in XR space so that all projections are satisfied at the same time.

What looks simple from one angle may fall apart from another.
Only by understanding the structure as a whole can you discover the solution.

[ Key Features ]
- Unique Projection-Based Puzzles
Solve spatial challenges by matching multiple orthographic projections simultaneously.

- Intuitive XR Interaction
Place and adjust blocks using VR controllers or natural hand pinch gestures.
Switch between a full VR environment and a passthrough background 

- Calm, Meditative Atmosphere
Soft pastel visuals and ambient sound design create a relaxing experience.

- Thoughtful Difficulty Progression
Easy to start, but increasingly rewarding as puzzles grow more complex.
